methods_quotes.q: ED visits and hospitalizations were weighted to represent the U.S. population using survey procedures in SAS statistical software (version 9.4; SAS Institute).
Rates of ED visits and hospitalizations were age-adjusted to the 2000 U.S. standard population using the direct method.
